name: Spotify Terms and Conditions of Use
text:
Spotify Terms and Conditions of Use. Last updated: January 2026.

1. Billing, Renewal, and Cancellation.
If you purchase a Paid Subscription, your payment to Spotify will automatically renew at the end of the applicable subscription period, unless you cancel your Paid Subscription before the end of the current subscription period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the Free Service. We do not provide refunds or credits for any partial subscription periods.

2. Service Changes.
We may occasionally make changes to the Spotify Service, including features, content, and subscription prices. We will notify you of material price increases at least 30 days in advance, and your continued use after the effective date constitutes your agreement to the new price.

3. Limitation of Liability.
You agree that your sole and exclusive remedy for any problems or dissatisfaction with the Spotify Service is to uninstall the Spotify software and to stop using the Spotify Service. In no event will Spotify, its officers, shareholders, employees, agents, directors, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, suppliers, or licensors be liable for any indirect, special, incidental, punitive, exemplary, or consequential damages.
